prompt:
Hi — we just finished final-round interviews for our Head of Regulatory Affairs opening at Verdant Biopharma. The panel interviewed three candidates over three days and left rough notes in `/workspace/recruiting/pipeline/biotech/`. We need formal evaluation documents before our hiring committee meets on Friday.

Please read through the interview notes for all three candidates (Miriam Osei-Bonsu, Tariq Abubakar-Hassan, and Svetlana Volkov-Petrov) and produce:
1. A formal scorecard for each candidate (save each as a `.md` file named after the candidate).
2. A single ranked comparison summary (save as `comparison_summary.md`) that shows all three candidates side-by-side with a final hire recommendation.

The scores in the notes are the panel's final agreed-upon scores — use them as-is. Make sure the math checks out.
